text:
Alex: spotted EU2 gpu-pool-3 throughput drop ~30%, lots of OOM evictions. Pagerbot fired three times in the last 7m. Can SRE take?
Priya: I'm on it. Looking at eviction logs and node metrics. Any recent deploys?
Alex: no deploys in last hour. Autoscaler bumped down some preemptible nodes earlier but not tied to this.
Pagerbot: ALERT: evictions > 0.5/s in eu2; affected pool: gpu-pool-3; current rate: 0.78/s; paging oncall.
Priya: running quick check:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -l pool=gpu-pool-3 -o json | jq '.items[] | {name: .metadata.name, status: .status.phase, restarts: .status.containerStatuses[].restartCount}' | head -n 10
```
Priya: result shows multiple `OOMKilled` restarts on model-serving pods (batch workers) and one node with 95% memory used.
Marco: tagging infra: gpu-pool-3 has a recent kernel bump; could be memory regression in runtime. Also saw high kernel slab usage on node gpu-eu2-07.
Sam: can we route some traffic to eu1 short-term? We have spare dedicated capacity there.
Alex: yes, suggest gradual shift 20% -> 50% if recovery not within 10m. Set route: `traffic-class=best-effort` to eu1; keep pinned low-latency customers on eu2.
Priya: taking mitigation steps:
- cordon node gpu-eu2-07
- drain non-critical pods
- enable burst-capacity from reserved-dedicated pool in eu1 (config change)
- raise pagerbot dampening window to 8m for eu2 evictions to reduce noise

Priya: running drain now:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-eu2-07
kubectl drain gpu-eu2-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
Pagerbot: INFO: paging policy updated by Priya: eu2 evictions dampening=8m
Marco: I'm provisioning 4 more dedicated GPUs in eu1 as burst. ETA 6m.
Sam: I'll start traffic-shift script, will bump 20% now.
Sam: `/opt/runbooks/shift-traffic.sh --from eu2 --to eu1 --percent 20 --route best-effort`
Oncall-Bot: runbook started: shift-traffic (id rtb-199800)
Alex: good. Keep updates in this thread. If evictions drop below 0.1/s and node memory stabilizes, we'll reverse the burst and uncordon.
Priya: 6m update: evictions down to 0.22/s after drains, memory pressure easing on drained nodes. Continuing monitoring. Need to track kernel slab metrics.
Marco: kernel regression ticket created: INFRA-8423. Will roll back kernel on gpu-eu2-07 if slab doesn't drop in 30m.
Sam: traffic now at 20% eu1, p50 latency unchanged for pinned customers.
Alex: OK — plan: keep burst in eu1 for 30m, monitor evictions and slab. If stable, we de-escalate and uncordon. Sam, please take the handoff at 11:30 and post summary then.
Sam: acknowledged, will handoff at 11:30 and paste summary + checklist.
Alex: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
